about.name: Wesson
about.bio1: Wesson is a Detroit-based artist whose work explores the beauty of human connection — the moments of togetherness, leadership, and joy that define community. Rooted in the visual tradition of Romare Bearden, his paintings and illustrations pulse with vibrant color and dynamic linework, inviting viewers into scenes that feel both familiar and alive. Whether working on canvas, in illustration, or through his ongoing archival photography, Wesson brings a multidisciplinary perspective shaped by years of practice at the intersection of fine art and design. His work is a love letter to Detroit - and to the people who make it.
about.bio2: Wesson is a Detroit-based artist whose practice moves fluidly between portraiture, street observation, and character illustration - always in pursuit of the human story underneath. Rooted in the visual legacy of Romare Bearden, his work carries that same commitment to Black life, community, and cultural memory, rendered through bold color, expressive linework, and a distinctly urban sensibility. Conceptually, Wesson is drawn to the ordinary moments that reveal something larger - the gesture, the gathering, the glance - and his digital work brings those observations to life with an energy that feels both grounded and alive.
